sentences.en: Our house has scaffolding around it this week, due to renovations.
sentences.zh: 这周我们家周围搭起了脚手架，因为正在进行装修。

sentences.en: This is the tallest scaffolding I've ever seen in my life.
sentences.zh: 这是我这辈子见过的最高的脚手架。

sentences.en: The honeycomb structure gives the scaffolding its sturdiness.
sentences.zh: 蜂窝状结构赋予了脚手架稳固性。

senses.zh: 给…搭脚手架；用支架支撑
